name: opensearchserverless
description: Use the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless API to create, configure, and manage OpenSearch Serverless collections and security policies.

subcommands.name: batch-get-collection
subcommands.description: Returns attributes for one or more collections, including the collection endpoint, the OpenSearch Dashboards endpoint, and FIPS-compliant endpoints.

subcommands.name: batch-get-collection-group
subcommands.description: Returns attributes for one or more collection groups, including capacity limits and the number of collections in each group.

subcommands.name: batch-get-effective-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Returns a list of successful and failed retrievals for the OpenSearch Serverless indexes.

subcommands.name: batch-get-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Returns one or more configured OpenSearch Serverless lifecycle policies.

subcommands.name: batch-get-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Returns attributes for one or more VPC endpoints associated with the current account.

subcommands.name: create-access-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a data access policy for OpenSearch Serverless.

subcommands.name: create-collection
subcommands.description: Creates a new OpenSearch Serverless collection.

subcommands.name: create-collection-group
subcommands.description: Creates a collection group within OpenSearch Serverless.

subcommands.name: create-index
subcommands.description: Creates an index within an OpenSearch Serverless collection.

subcommands.name: create-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a lifecyle policy to be applied to OpenSearch Serverless indexes.

subcommands.name: create-security-config
subcommands.description: Specifies a security configuration for OpenSearch Serverless.

subcommands.name: create-security-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a security policy to be used by one or more OpenSearch Serverless collections.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates an OpenSearch Serverless-managed interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-access-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenSearch Serverless access policy.

subcommands.name: delete-collection
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenSearch Serverless collection.

subcommands.name: delete-collection-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a collection group.

subcommands.name: delete-index
subcommands.description: Deletes an index from an OpenSearch Serverless collection.

subcommands.name: delete-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenSearch Serverless lifecycle policy.

subcommands.name: delete-security-config
subcommands.description: Deletes a security configuration for OpenSearch Serverless.

subcommands.name: delete-security-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenSearch Serverless security policy.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenSearch Serverless-managed interface endpoint.

subcommands.name: get-access-policy
subcommands.description: Returns an OpenSearch Serverless access policy.

subcommands.name: get-account-settings
subcommands.description: Returns account-level settings related to OpenSearch Serverless.

subcommands.name: get-index
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an index in an OpenSearch Serverless collection, including its schema definition.

subcommands.name: get-policies-stats
subcommands.description: Returns statistical information about your OpenSearch Serverless access policies, security configurations, and security policies.

subcommands.name: get-security-config
subcommands.description: Returns information about an OpenSearch Serverless security configuration.

subcommands.name: get-security-policy
subcommands.description: Returns information about a configured OpenSearch Serverless security policy.

subcommands.name: list-access-policies
subcommands.description: Returns information about a list of OpenSearch Serverless access policies.

subcommands.name: list-collection-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of collection groups.

subcommands.name: list-collections
subcommands.description: Lists all OpenSearch Serverless collections.

subcommands.name: list-lifecycle-policies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of OpenSearch Serverless lifecycle policies.

subcommands.name: list-security-configs
subcommands.description: Returns information about configured OpenSearch Serverless security configurations.

subcommands.name: list-security-policies
subcommands.description: Returns information about configured OpenSearch Serverless security policies.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the tags for an OpenSearch Serverless resource.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoints
subcommands.description: Returns the OpenSearch Serverless-managed interface VPC endpoints associated with the current account.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates tags with an OpenSearch Serverless resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag or set of tags from an OpenSearch Serverless resource.

subcommands.name: update-access-policy
subcommands.description: Updates an OpenSearch Serverless access policy.

subcommands.name: update-account-settings
subcommands.description: Update the OpenSearch Serverless settings for the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: update-collection
subcommands.description: Updates an OpenSearch Serverless collection.

subcommands.name: update-collection-group
subcommands.description: Updates the description and capacity limits of a collection group.

subcommands.name: update-index
subcommands.description: Updates an existing index in an OpenSearch Serverless collection.

subcommands.name: update-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Updates an OpenSearch Serverless access policy.

subcommands.name: update-security-config
subcommands.description: Updates a security configuration for OpenSearch Serverless.

subcommands.name: update-security-policy
subcommands.description: Updates an OpenSearch Serverless security policy.

subcommands.name: update-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Updates an OpenSearch Serverless-managed interface endpoint.
